about: Land mobile: which terrestrial filings are new foreign land mobile stations, the only kind this screen covers.

classes.FB: Base station in the land mobile service

classes_basis: Traficom, 7 November 2026: land mobile only, classes as listed in the BR IFIC terrestrial preface; fixed stations stay out.

reasons.recorded: It is already in the Master Register (stage RECORDED), not a new notice in this issue.
reasons.not_land_mobile: It is not a land mobile station (class {class}). This screen covers base stations (FB) and land mobile stations (ML) only.

notes: Reasons are tried in the order above; a filing gets the first that is true.
